image_description: A close-up, underwater photograph of a lionfish (Pterois). The fish displays characteristic reddish-brown and white vertical stripes. Its most prominent features are the large, fan-like pectoral fins with elongated rays and the dorsal fin spines fanning out like a mane. The head is visible on the right side, showing a large eye and mouth structure. The background is dark and blurry, suggesting an aquarium or reef environment.
